decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that fits the spare-parts and after-sales business, it likely remains above a modest aspiration level and is cheap to carry under existing slack.
This box car trailer series is close to the firm's core offering, was prominently marketed, and likely meets aspiration levels well enough to justify continued support.
The car transporter trailer is a more specialized niche line, so it faces a higher risk if sales lag aspirations, but its fit with professional users still makes retention slightly more likely.
The low-bed trailer series matches the firm's core capabilities and customer base, so management would likely keep it unless performance clearly fell short of comparable trailer lines.
The high trailer cover series complements core trailers and can piggyback on existing production and dealer channels, making continuation likely despite some uncertainty.

Because this second box car trailer series appears overlapping with other core lines, a medium-sized firm focused on efficient logistics would be relatively likely to rationalize it if results are only average.
